title: Perplexity Personal Computer for Mac
summary: An autonomous AI agent for macOS that integrates with the local file system and native applications to execute multi-step workflows. It functions as a personal orchestrator, performing tasks like file organization and email drafting through probabilistic goal completion.
research_notes: Features a universal 'double-Command' shortcut and deep integration with the Comet browser for visual interaction with web tools without APIs.

evolution.summary: Launched in early 2026 as a cloud-based sandbox, it evolved into a native macOS app in April 2026. Initially exclusive to the $200/month Max tier, it was expanded in May 2026 to all Pro and Enterprise subscribers, deprecating the legacy Perplexity Mac app.
